advisor_identified: Historian of modern Mexico and Latin American cultural history at York University; supervisor of the listed cabaret-history dissertation.

doctorate.institution: Rutgers, The State University of New Jersey
doctorate.title: Mexico "Sin Vicios": Conservatives, Comic Books, Censorship and the Mexican State, 1934-1976

evidence.says: York names Anne Rubenstein as supervisor of Sophia Koutsoyannis’s dissertation on Mexico City cabarets, matching the first student dissertation in this entry.
Her institutional CV identifies her as a York history professor and records a history PhD from Rutgers awarded in October 1994, with a thesis on Mexican censorship and comic books.
Michigan State University Libraries catalogues the dissertation under Anne G. Rubenstein as a Rutgers PhD thesis from 1994, with the full title recorded above; call number PN6790.M4R8 1994.
York’s faculty profile identifies Anne G. Rubenstein as a history professor researching modern Latin American cultural history and lists a Rutgers history PhD.

notes: The linked record matches the author, institution, year and dissertation, but its title is truncated after 1934. The library catalogue supplies 1934-1976. Her CV gives the variant title “México sin vicios: Censorship, Conservatives, Comic Books and the State 1936-1974”; the doctorate title here follows the library catalogue.
